paragraphs: I'm applying for the Deal Finance Senior Associate role in Strategy and Execution. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm drawn to Deal Finance because it sits where modeling meets a real client decision, and that's the part of finance I want to build my career in.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario models to evaluate capital allocation, improving capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget options. In my MBA coursework I built a DCF and an LBO model for J.M. Smucker and checked the DCF against a sell-side model. I don't have live deal experience, but I'm comfortable building a model from scratch and stress-testing it.
I'd bring careful modeling, clear presentation of the numbers and steady work with clients and teammates. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the role.
